warning: Fresh 2026-10-26 fallback-API reference; it does not reconstruct the historical screenshot or its 28 candidates. The /map.json rectangle is broader than the 500 m circle and the project applies mapBuildingWays plus nearbyRoofCandidates locally.

parameters.distanceRule: rounded haversine distance from query center to measured polygon centroid; <= radius
parameters.areaRule: existing measureFootprint projected-area approximation; minimum inclusive; max 100000 m2
parameters.order: descending areaM2; source order retained for ties

source.captureMethod: OSM map API fallback already used by osm-footprint-client.mjs for searches up to 500 m; canonicalized to building ways and their referenced node coordinates only. OSM user names, user IDs, changesets and unrelated elements are omitted. Building tag is retained because it is the field consumed by mapBuildingWays.
